content.description: An NFT that gives you the ability to be your own t-shirt producer and distributor. For only 50 $ADA the NFTs will include: - Free shirt you can deliver to your address, we offer free delivery in 49 countries - Lifetime access to buy as many shirts of your design, for only 20$, with free delivery in 49 countries - 3D model of your shirt. In the future, when we partner with gaming and metaverse platforms, you may be able to use your NFT as a digital shirt. - 5% discount on any mint from our store (up to 10% when we incorporate new designs) Visit our store https://cardanomerch.nmkr.store/
